headline: Argentina Postpones Fuel Tax Increases Until December
summary: The Argentine government issued Decree 1305/2026, postponing pending tax hikes on gasoline and diesel until at least December 1 to limit retail price pressures.
why: Fuel taxes in Argentina directly impact retail transport costs and inflation gauges, which remain central to the country's macroeconomic stabilization program.

impacts.name: Argentine Fuel Retailers
impacts.why: Postponing tax hikes halts immediate pump price increases, delaying pass-through costs to consumers.
